key_structures: Central sanctum with sacred Doli (palanquin / swing)
special_features: Unique absence of an anthropomorphic idol: devotees revere a wooden swing (Doli) over a marble platform representing the disappearing (Alopa) form of Devi
Continuous canopy of sacred red threads tied by devotees for fulfillment of vows
Located near the confluence of Ganga, Yamuna, and mystical Saraswati
renovation_history: Puranic sanctum anciently known as Madhaveswari; sanctum renovated and marble complex built in late 19th and early 20th century by local devotee guilds.
